title: Flight Deck / Sailing Deck (Flight Mode, Sailing Mode, Wolf Air)
layout_order: glareshield strip across the top of the deck, left to right: MASTER WARNING, MASTER CAUTION | A/T, IAS window, SPD knob | LNAV, VNAV | HEADING window, HDG knob, HDG SEL | ALTITUDE window, ALT knob, ALT HOLD | VERT SPEED window, V/S wheel, V/S | CMD | RANGE knob, PLAN, HUD, CAM, MAP, INV, REZ, AIRPORTS, PANEL, HELP, MINI | EXIT (sailing: WARNING, CAUTION | TRACK | HEADING, HDG knob, HDG | WIND ANGLE, TWA knob, WIND, TACK | MOTOR, SPEED, SPD knob | AUTO | RANGE, PLAN, MAP, INV, REZ, CLUB, PANEL, HELP, MINI | EXIT) | instrument row left to right: clock, gear lever + lights + ENG, sidestick + throttle, PFD, ND/PLAN, EICAS (warplane: JET, ENGINES, COMBAT), CDU (screen with LSK L1-L6 left and R1-R6 right, keys DIR TO APT CTL EXEC over CLR DEL HELP) (sailing: clock, helm wheel + motor lever + SAIL/ENG, wind dial, speed/depth/VMG, chart/PLAN, EICAS, CDU; crew: clock, CREW, TURRET, BOMBSIGHT, ENGINES, COMBAT) | top edge = size handle | over the world: HUD, PULL UP/TERRAIN, air overlay, radar (lower right, movable), quick guide | mini bar alternative: one centred bar of cells AP A/T IAS ALT HDG V/S DEST then REZ INV FULL EXIT

sizes.note: Smallest press targets, worked out from the code. The deck is laid out H tall and drawn at zoom = WolfFlightDeckScale (WolfHudScale MIN_SCALE 0.4 .. 1.0); a target's on-screen size is its picture size x zoom (hitAt divides the click by mHitScale = zoom).
citations: wolfflightdeck.cpp:713-714  H = llclamp(Hv * 0.34f, 200.f, 430.f); H = llmin(H, (Hv - screen_bottom) * 0.62f)
wolfflightdeck.cpp:767-769, 840  D = (H - M - 1.8 * 0.04 H), then D = llmin(D, Dw) (the screen width can make it smaller still)
wolfflightdeck.cpp:3050-3057, 3121  CDU: w = 0.84 D, lsk_w = 0.085 w, lh = (0.64 D) / 14, the LSK hit is lsk_w wide and 0.9 lh tall
wolfflightdeck.cpp:1040, 1099, 1179-1192  glareshield: u = llmin(M, ...); a button is s = llmin(w*u, M) * 0.78 square; the V/S wheel hit is 0.46 u wide
wolfflightdeck.cpp:3134  CDU function keys kh = 0.085 D tall
wolfflightdeck.cpp:3176  mini bar h = llclamp(Hv * 0.055f, 36.f, 56.f), drawn unscaled (mHitScale = 1)
wolfflightdeck.cpp:3571  radar - + X: bs = 0.075 x the scope height (WolfAirRadarSize 0.12..0.40 of the view), unscaled
sizes.smallest: the CDU line select keys (H_LSK_*): 0.0714 D wide x 0.0411 D tall. Full size (zoom 1.0): with H = 430 (M 54, D 345) 24.6 x 14.2 px; with H = 200 (M 30, D 155.6) 11.1 x 6.4 px. At MIN_SCALE 0.4: 9.9 x 5.7 px (H 430) down to 4.4 x 2.6 px (H 200).
sizes.others: glareshield buttons at most 0.741 u = 40 px square at full size and the largest window (u = M = 54), 16 px at MIN_SCALE; the V/S wheel 24.8 px wide at best (9.9 px at 0.4); CDU function keys 0.085 D = 29.3 px tall at best (11.7 px at 0.4); mini bar keys h = 36..56 px tall, unscaled; radar - + X 16.2 px at the default 0.20 size on a 1080 px view. No target on the deck reaches 44 px on both sides today except the mini bar cells on a tall window, the stick and lever areas, and the screens (ND, CDU) used as buttons.
